source_document.title: document title
source_document.version_or_year: version, edition, or publication year when available
source_document.url_or_doi: public URL or DOI when available
source_document.license_or_terms: license, terms of use, or access note

retrievable_chunk.source_id: identifier linking the chunk to source_document
retrievable_chunk.section_title: chapter, section, or heading used during chunking
retrievable_chunk.redistribution_note: Only metadata and configuration are included when the underlying source text cannot be redistributed.
